prompt: Blue brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Big Toy Box
irony: Blue brings the biggest toy box to hold all the toys, but the empty toy box is more fun than any toy inside, so she becomes the toy inside it.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Evening at the big house porch, Blue stands beside a towering toy box.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants to sort every toy by fact cards and corrects Blue about the toy box size.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares them to shove the giant toy box through the front door and it wedges tight.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All four push the wedged toy box together chanting about the big toy box.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: They drag the toy box onto the street, tip it, and toys spill across the pavement.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Empty now, the giant toy box rolls downhill with Green and Navy giggling inside.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Under streetlamps the kids dance around the toy box singing the big toy box chant.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue sits by the toy box and admits buying big toys to feel like the fun one.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue decides time beats stuff, tosses the fact cards, and climbs into the toy box.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Blue climbs in as the toy, the kids roar with joy, and the street sings the turned chant.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Night on the street, the empty toy box glows as a playhouse and Blue plays inside.
